title: Same Tree
description:
Given the roots of two binary trees p and q , write a function to check if they are the same or not. 
 
 Two binary trees are considered the same if they are structurally identical, and the nodes have the same value. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/12/20/ex1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 p = [1,2,3], q = [1,2,3]

Output:
 true
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/12/20/ex2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 p = [1,2], q = [1,null,2]

Output:
 false
```

 Example 3: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/12/20/ex3.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 p = [1,2,1], q = [1,1,2]

Output:
 false
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in both trees is in the range [0, 100] . 
 
 -10 4 <= Node.val <= 10 4
